name: BIOL 101 unit quiz

sections.instructions: Choose the ONE best answer for each question. Circle the letter of your choice. Each question is worth 1 point.

voice_notes: Stems are direct questions or sentence completions ending in a colon.
Every fifth question (5, 10, 15, 20) is a negative item with EXCEPT or NOT in capitals.
About three questions per quiz open with a short scenario: "A student observes...".
Options are short noun phrases in sentence case with no closing period.
No "all of the above" or "none of the above" options.

exemplars.text:
Which organelle modifies, sorts and packages proteins for export from the cell?
A. Nucleolus
B. Golgi apparatus
C. Peroxisome
D. Centrosome

All of the following are examples of passive transport EXCEPT:
A. Osmosis
B. Simple diffusion
C. The sodium-potassium pump
D. Facilitated diffusion

A student places a plant cell in distilled water. The cell does not burst because of its:
A. Central vacuole
B. Cell wall
C. Chloroplasts
D. Plasma membrane
